d: Veterinary bills and an impending IRS audit worry Jean  Kris gets a waitressing job  Matt falls deeper into the world of gambling.
Kris promises to go on a date with Junior if he will stake a claim on Wildfire in an upcoming race  Dani learns that Bobby is married.
Kris, Matt, Junior and Dani head to the mountains when their horses are lost in a stampede  Jean's ex-husband interrupts her date with Charlie.
Wildfire loses a big race after ingesting potentially lethal cattle feed  Matt must sell his motorcycle to cover gambling debts.
Matt and Junior throw a party while Jean is away at a horse show  Kris worries about the arrival of an old friend from the past.
Kris ignores her studies and ranch responsibilities to train with a famous female jockey  Dani seeks the truth about her mother's identity.
Tina introduces Kris to painkillers  Matt is upset when Kris goes out with Junior  Dani meets a woman she believes is her mother.
A television crew arrives at Raintree to document Tina's training  Matt is angered after learning that his father visited the ranch.
Kris is selected to ride Wildfire after star jockey Tina Sharp is lured away by the Davis family  Matt's gambling addiction rages out of control.
